Hi Alicia / Tom —

Thanks again for taking the demo this morning. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we’re aligned before we lock the trial plan:  

What we heard you want to validate in the 4-week POC:
- Core: replace current chat fallback with Redwood-powered reranking for product search (baseline acceptance: 95% top-3 relevance on our sample set)
- New asks (requested on call): 1) New-user onboarding intent routing to personalized flows; 2) Fraud-alert triage for low-confidence transactions (lightweight classification + human-in-loop escalation)

Proposed changes to POC to accommodate the two new asks:
1) Expand trial scope to include both onboarding and fraud triage as secondary tracks (parallel to search reranking).
2) Add explicit success criteria per track (see attached Mutual Action Plan v2).
3) Add test-data templates and a small seeded dataset from BrightCart for fraud signals (see related links).
4) Recommended timeline shift: push end date by 1 week to allow for seeded-data ingestion and one extra evaluation sprint.

Ask from Redwood: please confirm owners for each track and whether you can provide a small sample dataset for the fraud use case by Friday. Once we get owners, I’ll loop in Marissa (CS lead) and Priyom (solutions eng) to finalize acceptance metrics and test harness.

Attached: BrightCart_POC_MutualActionPlan_v2.xlsx (MAP with proposed milestones).

Next call: if that works I can schedule a 30-min alignment this Thursday to finalize the MAP and kickoff data transfer.

Thanks —
Sean

Quick internal -> external ready draft (I’ve included the customer here so they see the proposed acceptance matrix):

Summary of acceptance criteria (per-track):
1) Search reranking (core) — baseline preserved
   - Metric: top-3 relevance on labeled sample (BrightCart sample v1). Acceptance: >= 95% top-3 relevance and no more than 5% regression vs current baseline on the same dataset.
2) New-user onboarding intent routing (priority 2)
   - Metric: intent classification F1 on onboarding sample. Acceptance: F1 >= 0.82 OR measurable drop in onboarding drop-off by >= 6% in synthetic A/B within trial window.
   - Data needs: 2-week event sample + mapping table for onboarding flows.
3) Fraud-alert triage (priority 3)
   - Metric: triage precision@top1 for flagged alerts; secondary metric: reduction in manual review volume. Proposed acceptance: precision@top1 >= 0.78 AND manual review volume decreased by >= 18% on seeded dataset (or equivalent confidence-lift relative to a simple rule baseline).
   - Data needs: seeded fraud CSV (500 rows) + definition of current manual review rules.

Evaluation plan & ownership:
- Data ingestion & sandbox setup: Priyom (SE) — will provide an ingestion checklist and a sandbox intake form by EOD.
- Labeling / test harness and daily eval: Marissa (CS) + BrightCart data owner (Christina/Tom) — we’ll run daily evals and provide a short daily digest.
- Final sign-off: Alicia + Redwood CS (Marissa). Acceptance gates must be met on the final three-day rolling eval window.

Timeline (updated):
- Fri 26 Mar: BrightCart delivers fraud CSV (500 rows).
- Tue 30 Mar: BrightCart delivers onboarding events export.
- Wed 31 Mar: Redwood sandbox ready, initial ingestion complete.
- Thu 01 Apr: Mid-trial check-in (data health + preliminary metrics).
- Fri 09 Apr: Trial end (extended by one week). Final three-day rolling window: 07–09 Apr for acceptance metrics.

Risks & mitigations:
- Risk: seeded fraud set not representative -> Mitigation: run cross-checks vs rule baseline and require BrightCart to add 3 false-positive examples if possible.
- Risk: data mapping delays -> Mitigation: Priyom to provide mapping template and a single 1-hour pairing session with BrightCart data owner.

Attachments: eval_checklist_v3.docx (internal checklist and acceptance template).

I’ll be on the Thursday 11:00 PT call to walk through the MAP and finalize owners.

-Marissa
